decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed two-storey side and two-storey rear extensions, due to their size, position and appearance, would fail to be secondary to the size of the original house and would form a bulky and obtrusive feature on this highly visible corner, detrimental to the character of the original pair of semi-detached houses, and the appearance of the streetscene, and detrimental to the visual amenity of the adjoining Green Belt. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and ENV 4.7 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4. and ENV-N.1.5 (January 2001) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
description: Erection of two storey side extension and two storey rear extension to form 'Granny flat'
